jobs.title: Project Manager Senior
jobs.description:
At Associated Bank we strive to create an inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued and recognized as strengths critical to our success. If you thrive in an environment where your growth and development are encouraged and supported, then Associated Bank may be the right place for you.

Associated Bank requires you to directly represent yourself and your own experiences during the recruiting and hiring process. Associated Bank conducts a thorough background check on all new hires.

Role Summary

The Project Manager Senior is responsible for leading and delivering strategic business initiatives that support organizational goals and drive successful outcomes. This role serves as a key point of contact for business partners, leadership, project teams, and third-party vendors while providing oversight throughout the full project lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings strong project leadership, analytical thinking, and the ability to manage complex initiatives with a high degree of autonomy.

Key Accountabilities

Lead cross-functional teams in the successful execution and implementation of strategic projects.
Develop and manage project plans, timelines, budgets, resources, and scope to ensure project success.
Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, and implement effective mitigation strategies.
Drive projects through the full lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design collaboration, testing, training, production readiness, and change management.
Prioritize and coordinate multiple interrelated initiatives based on business value, scope, schedule, and resource requirements.
Provide leadership, coaching, and mentorship to project team members and less-experienced project managers.
Conduct research and analysis to define requirements, evaluate feasibility, and support informed decision-making.
Partner with vendors and third parties throughout selection, contract review, and ongoing project execution processes.

Required

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
4-7 years of experience in banking, business, or project management.
Knowledge of project management principles, methodologies, and best practices.
5-7 years of experience leading projects in a project management role.
Experience using Portfolio and Project Management (PPM) tools.
Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, high-visibility initiatives.
Strong analytical judgment across scope, schedule, cost, and risk management.
Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and resource constraints and develop effective solutions.

Preferred

Project Management certification.
Strong executive and senior stakeholder communication skills.
Experience leading large cross-functional teams without direct authority.
Experience mentoring less-experienced project managers.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

You'll have the opportunity to lead high-impact strategic initiatives that influence business outcomes across the organization. This role offers significant autonomy, exposure to senior leaders, and the ability to collaborate with diverse teams while driving meaningful change. If you enjoy solving complex challenges and delivering results, this is an excellent opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Apply today to make an impact.

We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified parties, including but not limited to people returning to the workforce, people with disabilities, those without a college degree, and veterans or those with military experience.

In addition to core traditional benefits, we take pride in offering benefits for every stage of life.

Retirement savings including both 401(k) and Pension plans.
Paid time off to volunteer in your community.
Opportunities to connect with others through our diversity-focused Colleague Resource Groups.
Competitive salaries with professional development and advancement opportunities.
Bonus benefits including well-being programs and incentives, parental leave, an employee stock purchase plan, military benefits and much more.
Personal banking, loan, investment and insurance benefits.

Associated Bank serves more than 120 communities throughout Wisconsin, Illinois, Minnesota, and Missouri and we consider our colleagues critical to our continued success. See why our colleagues continually vote us a best place to work in the Midwest. Join our community on Facebook, LinkedIn and X. 

Artificial Intelligence Statement

To support our recruiting process, we may use artificial intelligence ("AI") or automated technologies to collect, organize, sort, and analyze information submitted by applicants. These tools may assist our Talent Acquisition professionals in identifying applicants who appear to satisfy the minimum qualifications for a position.

AI is not used to make employment decisions on behalf of Associated Bank. No applicant will be selected or rejected solely based on the output of an AI tool. Hiring decisions are made by Associated Bank personnel who review applicant information and exercise independent judgment in accordance with applicable law and company policies.

Compliance Statement

Associated Bank is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse workforce. We support a work environment where colleagues are respected and given the opportunity to perform to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or veteran status, among other factors.

Fully complies with all applicable enterprise policies and procedures. Acts in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations as outlined in training materials, including but not limited to Bank Secrecy Act. Responsible for reporting suspicious activity to Financial Intelligence. Responsible to report all customer complaints as prescribed and procedure violations to management or HR.

Responsible to report ethical concerns as needed to Associated Bank’s anonymous Ethics Hotline.

Associated Bank provides additional assistance throughout the application, interview and hiring process. Please contact leavesandaccommodations@associatedbank.com if you need an accommodation at any time during the process.

Associated Banc-Corp participates in the E-Verify Program. E-Verify Notice English or Spanish. Know Your Right to Work English or Spanish.

Associated Bank is Pay Transparency compliant.

The pay range represents anticipated base pay for this role. Actual pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, work location, skills, experience, education, and qualifications for the role.

For certain positions, total compensation may also include incentive, commission, or bonus opportunities not reflected in the posted base pay range.

$72,450.00 - $124,200.00 per year

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Technical Consulting Principal Project Manager

The Broadcom Mainframe Software Division (MSD) is looking for a Principal level IT Technical Project Manager to direct complex, high-stake cross functional software migration and related projects, typically overseeing portfolios related to program level engagements.

This role is related to MSD Technical Consulting Services billable engagements for large, diverse Fortune 500 companies. The Principal Project Manager defines governance and strategy, identifies and manages stakeholders, creates formal kickoff deliverables, builds project schedules, manages budgets, risks and issues provides expert leadership with a proven track record of successful execution managing mainframe software projects.

Ability to measure projects and independently drive execution and own responsibility for overall success of projects with experience documenting projects as reference/success stories. Accomplished project delivery is the key performance metric for this role.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Direction & Leadership: Driving large-scale, complex projects from inception to implementation, ensuring alignment with company goals.
Project Governance: Creating and implementing project policies, procedures, and quality control standards.
Financial & Risk Management: Establishing budgets, controlling costs, forecasting expenditures, and managing risk mitigation strategies.
Stakeholder Management: Communicating project status, risks, and ROI to executive leadership, while managing relationships with clients and internal partners.
Process Improvement: Analyzing operational efficiency and developing solutions, to streamline workflows.
Team Leadership: Mentoring and guiding project teams, delegating tasks, and managing Broadcom and customer project resources.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Experience: Bachelors in business, engineering, or a related field; certifications like PMP (Project Management Professional) are often preferred or 8+ years of related experience or Masters degree and 6+ years of related experience
Requires 6+ years of project management experience, often with a focus on cross-functional, large-scale projects.
1-3+ years of Mainframe Software project management experience required.
Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of project management tools, databases, and Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, MS Project).
Leadership/Soft Skills: Excellent communication, strategic thinking, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills.

Certification: PMP Certification or equivalent experience is preferred.

Compensation And Benefits

The annual base salary range for this position is USD 100,000.00 To USD 160,000.00

As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements.

Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
At Technatomy, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customer’s success. We provide solutions to agencies and entities including the Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, Defense Logistics Agency, National Institutes of Health, and more. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

Technatomy is seeking a Senior IT Project Manager to coordinate delivery and release readiness for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) pharmacy traceability project. You turn milestones into executable plans, track dependencies across technical teams, and organize evidence for releases and deployment waves. Working with the Program Manager and workstream leads, you keep commitments achievable and progress visible.

Duties And Responsibilities

Maintain the integrated project schedule, milestone dependencies, delivery commitments, and action tracking across workstreams.
Lead development, integration, testing, security, training, and deployment activities across Technatomy and subcontractor teams. Establish accountable owners, track commitments, and drive corrective action when delivery falls behind.
Organize release readiness and go/no-go reviews covering test results, security actions, required approvals, support documentation, cutover steps, and rollback readiness; record decisions and follow-up actions.
Track site readiness and deployment wave dependencies, including access, configuration, devices, training, and local coordination.
Manage delivery risks and issues, identify schedule impacts, and escalate decisions requiring program or customer direction.
Maintain clear status reports, decision records, meeting actions, and deliverable acceptance tracking.
Coordinate transition to service operations, confirm agreed handoff and stabilization exit criteria, and assign owners for open delivery items and known issues.
Develop recovery plans for delayed access, interfaces, or site readiness, and re-sequence dependent activities with workstream leads while maintaining milestone visibility.

Knowledge And Skills Required

At least 7 years of relevant professional experience in IT project management or enterprise application delivery.
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise application implementations involving SAP and/or Dynamics 365, integrated platforms, subcontractors, and customer stakeholders, with accountability for schedule, resources, and delivery outcomes.
Ability to build and maintain integrated schedules, identify critical dependencies, and coordinate corrective actions.
Experience coordinating software releases, readiness reviews, or deployment activities.
Working knowledge of Agile delivery and the relationship between sprint work, testing, milestones, and release controls.
Strong facilitation, status reporting, issue management, and stakeholder communication skills.
Ability to assess critical-path impacts, reconcile conflicting workstream plans, and maintain a reliable forecast of release and deployment readiness.

Knowledge And Skills Desired

Experience leading SAP implementations integrated with Azure services and Dynamics 365 SCM.
Prior experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other Federal agency applications or projects.
Experience coordinating enterprise application rollouts across multiple sites.
PMP certification or comparable project management training.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Clearance

Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

WORK LOCATION:

Remote

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments.
We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

This position requires U.S. citizenship.

Technatomy Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is the policy of Technatomy Corporation to afford equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, marital status, disability or veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Marketing Programs
jobs.description:
Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account

Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more.

About The Role

Happen Bank is looking for a Sr Technical Program Manager to drive the planning and execution of complex, cross-functional Marketing and Technology initiatives. In this role, you'll manage a portfolio of strategic programs, align stakeholders around priorities and dependencies, and ensure initiatives deliver measurable business outcomes.

You'll partner closely with Marketing, Product, Technology, Risk, and external vendors to translate business objectives into actionable plans, navigate complex challenges, and drive successful delivery from strategy through launch.

What You'll Do

Manage a portfolio of strategic Marketing and Technology initiatives, supporting planning and prioritization in alignment with Happen Bank's Product Development Life Cycle
Lead complex, cross-functional programs from ideation and strategy through planning, execution, and launch, ensuring delivery aligns with business objectives, timelines, and budgets
Partner with stakeholders across Technology, Product, Marketing, Business, and Risk to define requirements, establish priorities, and align teams around program goals and expected outcomes
Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, including milestones, resources, dependencies, critical paths, and delivery timelines, proactively identifying risks and resolving obstacles
Establish program dashboards, reporting, and performance metrics that provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and delivery outcomes
Drive cross-functional coordination and decision-making, facilitating working sessions, resolving issues, and maintaining clear communication and accountability across stakeholders
Prepare and present program updates, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to executive leadership, escalating critical issues and decisions as appropriate
Provide technical program leadership and guidance to project teams and stakeholders, partnering with platform vendors and cross-functional leaders to manage change, strengthen delivery practices, and ensure program commitments are met

About You

6+ years of technical program management experience within a technology organization, including leading complex, cross-functional initiatives
Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience
Demonstrated experience managing large-scale technical programs and projects from planning through implementation, including dependencies, risks, resources, and delivery milestones
Strong understanding of project and program management methodologies, including process improvement and change management
Excellent organizational, prioritization, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced, evolving environment
Strong communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align partners across Technology, Product, Marketing, Business, and Risk
Proven ability to independently drive execution, anticipate challenges, resolve complex issues, and deliver measurable business outcomes
Strong analytical judgment with the ability to evaluate tradeoffs, communicate risks, and provide clear recommendations to senior and executive stakeholders
You have hands-on experience using AI tools to accelerate program planning, risk identification, reporting, and problem-solving, and you're comfortable sharing effective approaches with colleagues while applying sound judgment around accuracy, data sensitivity, and where human oversight remains essential

Nice to Have

Experience with Agile and Scaled Agile delivery methodologies
Educational or professional background in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Management Information Systems, or a related technical discipline

Work Location

San Francisco

The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level.

Time Zone Requirements

Local hours (PT)

While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary.

Travel Requirements

As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed.

Compensation

The target base salary range for this position is 156,000-183,000. The base salary of the role will be determined by job-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings).

We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more.

Happen Bank is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We believe that a variety of perspectives will make our teams and business stronger as we work together to transform the traditional banking system.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at interviewaccommodations@happen.com.

Notice on AI Tool Use

For select roles and locations, candidate interviews may be recorded, transcribed and summarized by tools such as artificial intelligence (AI) to assist our hiring managers with the application process.

You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription, and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. We will not discriminate against you if you choose to opt out.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information from or about you: contact information, identifiers, professional and employment-related information, sensory information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment.

We will only share your interview, transcription, or summary with persons whose expertise or technology is necessary to process your application, evaluate your fitness for a position, and administer or support the tool. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, please refer to our Privacy Disclosure.

We will delete any recording of your interview promptly but in no event later than 30 days after making a hiring decision.

jobs.description:

Job Summary

Marriott is seeking an experienced FLEX Senior Program Manager, Corporate Systems to lead the end-to-end integration of the Vertex tax engine with Oracle ERP cloud (Payables & Receivables) and Source-to-pay systems. This role is pivotal in driving the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of global indirect tax automation, e-invoicing compliance and boundary systems integrations. This includes managing strategic design, global deployment, and optimization of tax integration, calculation, e-invoicing, and cross-border reporting compliance solutions within our next-generation cloud-based ERP financial platforms. This role collaborates with project management and business transformation teams as the technology implementation lead to manage priorities, communications, risks, issues and remove blockers.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Required

Education and Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), Business Administration, Accounting, Finance or equivalent practical experience.
7+ years of program management experience managing complex enterprise financial application rollouts, tax engines, and systems integrations
Core Systems Delivery Experience:
Demonstrated hands-on project delivery involving Vertex O Series indirect tax engine implementations (sales/use tax, VAT/GST determination, and tax content updates).
Proven experience managing integration deliverables between procurement platforms (Coupa, BirchStreet), central ERP and tax engines.

Integration Lifecycle Governance: Working knowledge of integration concepts (e.g., REST/SOAP APIs, middleware, SFTP batch processing), data mapping and error-handling workflows.
Quality Assurance & Cutover: Extensive experience in managing Integrated System Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), end-to-end reconciliation, cutover runbooks, and hypercare support models.
Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination: Strong track record holding third-party system integrators (SIs), software vendors (Coupa, Vertex, Birchstreet), and cross-functional technical teams accountable to strict delivery milestones and SLAs.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional and vendor-supported teams without direct authority
Proficiency with program management tools (e.g., Jira, MS Project, Smartsheet, Confluence)

Preferred

PMP, SAFe, Agile and ITIL v4 Certifications
Exposure to multi-country e-invoicing regimes (e.g., PEPPOL, SAF-T, real-time digital reporting requirements) and global hospitality/property-level operating models.
Experience with global tax requirements, including VAT, GST, and withholding tax
Background in process optimization, lean operations and procurement transformations.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Program Leadership & Delivery

Own the program plan, roadmap, and timeline for Vertex tax engine with our Oracle ERP cloud (Payables & Receivables) and Source-to-pay systems
Define program scope, objectives, success metrics, and governance structure
Manage dependencies across workstreams, including integration build, data mapping, testing, cutover, and hypercare
Drive phased or multi-region rollouts, balancing global standards with local tax requirements
Run steering committee meetings and deliver clear executive-level status reporting

Cross-Functional Coordination

Oversee Global Technology Services contribution to the program, including architecture, integration engineering, infrastructure, security, and support
Coordinate with the program team, including project managers, business analysts, technical leads, and workstream owners
Partner with Tax, Procurement, Finance, and AP stakeholders to define requirements for tax determination, exemption handling, and compliance
Manage relationships with vendors and system integrators (Vertex, Coupa, Birchstreet, and implementation partners)

Technical & Process Oversight

Ensure integration designs address tax calculation at requisition, PO, invoice, and sourcing/contract stages
Oversee data readiness, including supplier master, ship-to/ship-from addresses, product and service taxability codes, and exemption certificates
Validate alignment with ERP and downstream financial systems for tax posting and reconciliation
Confirm that testing strategy (unit, SIT, UAT, regression, and performance) covers key tax scenarios and edge cases
Support defect triage, release management, and go-live readiness decisions

Risk, Compliance & Governance

Identify, track, and mitigate program risks, issues, and dependencies

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

Tokiye Integrated Medical Services (TIMS) Ltd is a premier health systems development and management company based in Nigeria, with over 15 years of experience in healthcare project development and management. The organization focuses on problem-driven healthcare solutions for both public and private sector clients, supporting sustainable improvements in health service delivery. TIMS is fully indigenous and leverages local knowledge to design and implement context-appropriate interventions. With a multidisciplinary team whose expertise spans clinical care, project management, financing, and healthcare operations, and a combined experience of over 100 years, TIMS positions itself as a catalyst for enhanced healthcare value across Africa.

Role Description

The Programme Manager will lead and provide strategic and operational leadership for the organisation’s programmes supporting vulnerable women, children and families.
The role is responsible for identifying and assessing beneficiaries, developing measurable and cost-effective intervention plans, securing Board approvals, coordinating programme delivery, monitoring outcomes and reporting on impact. The Programme Manager will also establish and manage partnerships, oversee programme budgets, ensure safeguarding compliance and build a growing programme team as the organisation expands.

Key Responsibilities

1. Beneficiary Identification and Assessment

Receive and document cases from all referral channels, including field activities, community leaders, partners and Board members.
Record referral sources and any declared relationships or connections to beneficiaries
Screen applications against the organisation’s eligibility criteria within one week.
Conduct beneficiary verification through field visits and document reviews within three weeks.
Ensure consistent, transparent and impartial assessment of all cases.
Establish each beneficiary’s baseline circumstances and define measurable, achievable support outcomes.

2. Program Planning and Approval

Develop individual beneficiary support plans with clearly defined objectives, timelines, cost estimates, payment schedules, risks and follow-up arrangements.
Document beneficiaries’ pay-it-forward commitments as part of approved support plans.
Present cases and programme recommendations to the Board for approval.
Obtain further approval for significant changes to previously approved support plans.
Apply the organisation’s emergency approval procedure where immediate intervention is required, ensuring that all supporting documentation is completed afterwards.

3. Programme Budgeting and Financial Management

Prepare annual programme budgets, forecasts and funding requirements for Board approval.
Develop accurate cost estimates for individual interventions and recurring programmes.
Assess the value for money and financial implications of proposed interventions.
Monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets and promptly report variances, financial risks and emerging funding needs.
Approve programme running costs within delegated authority.
Prepare properly documented payment requests, referencing the relevant beneficiary case number or budget line.
Work closely with the Finance team on expenditure reconciliations, financial reporting and audits.
Ensure that all programme expenditure is supported by complete and accurate documentation.

4. Programme Implementation and Monitoring

Coordinate the delivery of approved interventions, directly or through qualified service providers and partners.
Where practicable, make payments directly to service providers such as schools, hospitals, landlords and suppliers rather than to individual beneficiaries.
Conduct beneficiary follow-ups at one, three and six months, with formal closeout assessments at approximately twelve months.
Evaluate whether intended outcomes have been achieved and document lessons learned.
Monitor beneficiaries’ compliance with agreed pay-it-forward commitments.
Maintain appropriate photographs, videos and case notes in accordance with the organisation’s consent, confidentiality and dignity standards.

5. Programme Development and Partnership Management

Coordinate approved recurring programmes, ensuring that beneficiaries are enrolled in line with established eligibility criteria.
Maintain accurate programme registers and implementation records.
Prepare quarterly programme performance reports and recommendations for annual programme renewal.
Identify, assess and establish relationships with potential implementation partners across relevant states.
Conduct partner due diligence, including verification of registration, financial records, leadership, safeguarding practices and operational capacity.
Conduct site visits before formalising partnerships.
Develop and manage written partnership agreements and monitor partner performance against agreed deliverables.

6. Safeguarding and Risk Management

Ensure strict adherence to the organisation’s safeguarding policies and code of conduct when working with children and vulnerable adults.
Serve as Deputy Safeguarding Lead and ensure safeguarding concerns are promptly reported, documented and escalated.
Ensure that safeguarding concerns are acted upon within twenty-four hours in accordance with organisational procedures.
Identify programme delivery risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

7. Reporting, Impact Measurement and Team Leadership

Develop and submit regular reports to the Board covering programme outcomes, expenditure, budget performance, risks and implementation progress.
Establish appropriate monitoring and evaluation processes to measure programme effectiveness and beneficiary outcomes.
Recruit, supervise, mentor and develop programme staff as the organisation expands.
Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations and accountability within the programme team.
Promote a culture of integrity, professionalism, collaboration and accountability.

Qualifications

Essential
A degree or professional qualification in Social Work, Sociology, Community Development, Public Health or a related discipline.
At least five years’ relevant experience in social work, community development or NGO programme management.
Demonstrable experience working with vulnerable women, children and families.
Experience preparing, managing and monitoring programme budgets.
Good financial literacy and ability to assess intervention costs and value for money.
Strong documentation, case management and report-writing skills.
Must be based in Port Harcourt and willing to travel within Nigeria.

Desirable Requirements
Knowledge of safeguarding principles and beneficiary case management practices.
Established relationships with NGOs, faith-based organisations and community-based organisations.
Experience establishing programmes, operational processes or systems within a new or growing organisation.
Good working knowledge of Rivers State and the wider South-South region.
Key Selflessness, compassion and commitment to serving vulnerable populations.
High integrity, discretion and impartiality.
Respect for the dignity, rights and confidentiality of beneficiaries.
Fairness and consistency in beneficiary selection and programme decisions.
A collaborative approach and willingness to support collective organisational decisions.
Reliability, accountability, self-motivation and strong organisational discipline.

Competencies and Skills

Programme planning, implementation and management.
Budgeting, financial monitoring and cost control.
Beneficiary assessment and case management.
Monitoring, evaluation and impact reporting.
Partnership development and stakeholder management.
Safeguarding and risk management.
Team leadership and people management.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Organisation, attention to detail and problem-solving.
Confidentiality and sound professional judgement.

Benefits

The organisation offers a competitive salary and benefits package commensurate with the successful candidate’s experience and responsibilities. This role also offers the opportunity to provide meaningful leadership, shape impactful programmes, improve the lives of vulnerable women and children, and contribute to the growth and long-term sustainability of a purpose-driven organisation.

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Security & Infrastructure PMO, dedicated to our Application Security and Platform Security teams in Long Beach. You will be the embedded program management partner to these two teams, driving execution from intake through delivery, running their operational rhythms, engaging with cross-functional software engineering teams, and keeping leadership's view of commitments and risk current and honest.

Application Security owns the security of the software we build: secure development practices, product and application security programs, vulnerability management, and the controls that keep our codebase and pipelines defensible. Platform Security owns the security of the environments that software runs in: cloud and platform security, identity and access management, infrastructure hardening, and the operational processes that keep those domains healthy. Your job is to make both teams more predictable and more effective—turning technical work into tracked, milestone-oriented programs and surfacing conflicts before they become delivery problems. It is also part engagement manager and part product manager: the company's software engineering teams are App Security and Platform Security's customers, and you help understand their needs and shape how security capabilities are delivered back to them.

This is a dedicated role, but not a static one. Your primary charter is Application Security and Platform Security, and that is where you'll build the deepest context. As portfolio priorities shift, you should expect to flex across other Security & Infrastructure programs when the PMO needs it, bringing the same execution rigor wherever you're pointed.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery for Application Security and Platform Security initiatives—building and maintaining the program plans, milestone schedules, and dependency maps in Jira, and driving them from intake through close

Partner with the team leads on effort estimation, task decomposition, and resource alignment across concurrent workstreams; surface capacity conflicts and schedule risk early, with options
Serve the software engineering teams as the primary customers of App Security and Platform Security—intake their requests, set expectations on what security can deliver and when, and keep that channel active rather than reactive
Manage cross-functional dependencies with software engineering, IT, GRC, cloud/platform, and external vendors and assessors
Produce leadership-ready program visibility—milestone-oriented, risk-flagged, and current—including the roll-ups and tear-sheets the PMO uses for steering
Partner with the PMO Lead on roadmap planning: prioritization, capacity planning, and keeping the plan of record maintained as priorities shift
Flex to other Security & Infrastructure programs as portfolio demand requires, bringing the same execution discipline to an unfamiliar domain

Qualifications

10+ years combining application and platform security with the technical program management of that work—deep in at least one domain (secure SDLC, vulnerability management, CI/CD pipeline security; cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management), credible in the other, with a track record of owning and running programs end to end
Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent workstreams with cross-functional dependencies and external stakeholders
Strong Jira or equivalent proficiency; able to build and maintain structured tracking across multi-team portfolios
Comfortable operating where scope, priorities, and assignments shift with portfolio demand
Clear, direct communicator; able to simplify complex status for executive audiences and push back when warranted
U.S. citizenship required; clearable required

Preferred Skills And Experience

Prior experience as an information security engineer who has since moved into technical program management (preferred over a TPM background without hands-on security experience)
Familiarity working directly with software engineering and platform/DevOps teams
Familiarity with NIST RMF, FedRAMP, or federal compliance environments
Experience in defense technology, aerospace, or DoD contractor environments

Compensation

Base Salary: $140,000-$210,000
Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.

This role provides strategic oversight of hospital outreach services, peer-delivered recovery support services, and all SUD housing programs located within Crook, Deschutes, and Jefferson Counties.

The Program Manager provides program-wide leadership, including clinical oversight, personnel management, peer workforce development, regulatory compliance, fiscal stewardship, and community partnership building. The Program Manager ensures peer services are delivered in alignment with trauma-informed, harm-reduction, and recovery-based principles while meeting all applicable Oregon Administrative Rules and organizational standards.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor degree behavioral health field preferred plus three (3) years of paid, full-time SUD experience, including at least one (1) year in an administrative or supervisory role; or field plus four (4) years of paid, full-time SUD experience, including at least one (1) year in an administrative or supervisory role; or High School Diploma (or equivalent) plus (5) ears of paid, full-time SUD and withdrawal management experience, including at least one (1) year in a supervisory role.
Applicants who are in recovery from a substance use disorder must have maintained a minimum of two consecutive years of recovery at the time of hire.

Required Licenses And Certifications

Current CADC-II required
Must maintain a valid Oregon Driver License or ability to obtain one upon hire and be insurable under the organization’s auto liability coverage policy (minimum 21 years of age and with no Type A violations in the past 3 years, or three (3) or more Type B violations) and must have a reliable vehicle with adequate insurance to travel as needed.

Preferred Experience

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Behavioral Health.

Experience supervising or developing peer support programs

Primary Job Duties

PROGRAM LEADERSHIP AND PEER SERVICES DEVELOPMENT

jobs.title: IT Project Manager (Business Applications)
jobs.description:
Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living.

Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come.

Job Purpose And Impact

The Project Manager supports the Digital Technology and Data (DT&D) team for Cargill’s Animal Nutrition & Health (ANH) business across the EMEAI & Global Salmon region. The role’s immediate priority will be to lead the portfolio of projects supporting Cargill’s regional SAP S/4HANA deployment, coordinating work across all business applications affected by the program. The role leads planning and delivery of cross-functional digital and technology projects in support of regional business priorities. It translates agreed priorities into integrated plans, coordinates teams across countries and time zones within the region, and manages scope, schedule, cost, resources, risks, dependencies, and quality. It partners with regional business stakeholders, country teams, product and application owners, technical teams, and vendors to deliver outcomes with clear governance and timely visibility.

This is a temporary replacement role with an expected duration of up to 2 years. We offer a hybrid working model following the onboarding period.

Key Accountabilities

PROJECT PLANNING AND GOVERNANCE: Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, decision rights, and governance. Build and maintain integrated plans that connect workstreams, dependencies, resource needs, and business outcomes.
CROSS-COUNTRY DELIVERY: Coordinate project teams and workstreams across countries within the EMEAI & Global Salmon region, clarify responsibilities, establish working routines, and keep work aligned with approved regional priorities and delivery plans.
PROJECT CONTROLS AND REPORTING: Monitor progress, schedule, costs, staffing, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and changes. Maintain accurate forecasts and provide concise, timely status reporting for project teams, sponsors, and leadership.
RISK AND ISSUE MANAGEMENT: Identify obstacles early, assess impact, develop mitigation or recovery actions, and resolve complex issues independently where appropriate. Escalate decisions and risks that require sponsor or leadership direction.
BUDGET AND RESOURCE COORDINATION: Work with project sponsors, product leaders, workstream owners, and functional managers to plan and track project funding, staffing, and capacity. Recommend corrective actions when delivery is at risk.
QUALITY AND DELIVERY READINESS: Coordinate requirements, acceptance criteria, quality reviews, testing, cutover, and readiness activities. Ensure project artifacts, decisions, and actions are documented and accessible.
VENDOR AND PARTNER COORDINATION: Coordinate vendor and partner deliverables, schedules, dependencies, and issue resolution as assigned; communicate performance concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
STAKEHOLDER COMMUNICATION: Build effective partnerships and tailor communications for regional, country, business, technical, and leadership audiences. Anticipate competing stakeholder needs and make decisions, trade-offs, and impacts clear.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and/or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of four years of related project management experience.
Experience planning and coordinating complex, cross-functional projects, including schedules, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and status reporting.
Ability to organize project teams, clarify accountabilities, manage competing priorities, and deliver through influence across countries within the EMEAI & Global Salmon region.
Ability to use AI tools effectively and responsibly to increase proficiency and productivity in the role.
English proficiency, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech with global business users, technical teams, and vendors.
Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time, as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering technology, enterprise application, ERP, manufacturing, or integration projects.
Experience coordinating projects across countries within the EMEAI & Global Salmon region and working with teams that have different local requirements.
Experience managing several interdependent initiatives or projects with significant cost, risk, or resource constraints.
Proficiency in one or more regional languages used across EMEAI & Global Salmon is a plus.

Benefits

Private healthcare.
My Benefits platform.
Lunch card.
Life insurance.
Opportunity to join the Employee Pension Program (PPE).
Working in an international environment.

Our Offer

We provide a fast paced stimulating international environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities and are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and workplace. We encourage candidates to let us know if they require any accommodations during the recruitment or interview process so we can support them appropriately.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Tharros
is seeking an accomplished Program Manager
to provide full accountability for the planning, execution, integration, and performance of mission assurance support for the Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division
Strategic and Computing Systems Department. The Program Manager will serve as Tharros’ principal interface with Government leadership and will direct a multidisciplinary team supporting defense critical infrastructure analysis, mission dependency and risk assessment, infrastructure vulnerability identification, engineering analysis, and related cyberspace programs.

The Program Manager will translate Government priorities into executable staffing, technical, schedule, quality, security, travel, and deliverable plans while maintaining qualified personnel across Key and Non-Key positions. The successful candidate will anticipate and resolve performance risks, integrate contractor and subcontractor activities, ensure the technical accuracy and timely delivery of contract products, and maintain continuity across continental United States and outside continental United States assessment activities.

Responsibilities

Provide overall management and integration of task-order performance across mission assurance, critical infrastructure, assessment, analysis, engineering, and program-support activities.
Coordinate contract execution with Government leadership and supported program offices, including planning priorities, staffing, schedules, deliverables, risks, issues, and required decisions.
Manage personnel, subcontractor, travel, security, quality, and administrative activities needed to sustain performance across continental United States and outside continental United States work locations.
Align contractor activities with Government direction and the mission of identifying infrastructure vulnerabilities and assessing risk to mission execution.
Oversee preparation, review, quality control, and timely delivery of technical, management, and assessment products.
Monitor staffing against the Government labor mix and maintain qualified, cleared personnel for key and non-key positions.
Identify program risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and performance issues; develop mitigation actions and track them through closure.
Maintain effective coordination among analysts, engineers, infrastructure specialists, assessment personnel, and program-support staff.
Protect classified and controlled information and ensure personnel comply with applicable facility, personnel, and information-security requirements.
Support transition, continuity, and knowledge retention across the base period and option periods.

Requirements

TS security clearance with Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) eligibility in DISS.
Master’s degree in a related technical area.
10 years of experience in program management of technical requirements of a comparable size and scope to this requirement to include tracking cost, schedule, and performance data.
Five (5) years demonstrated experience managing cost, workforce, and schedule to execute multiple complex tasks with frequent (both regular and adhoc) reprioritization, complying with Government reporting requirements, and implementing cost control over complex projects.
Experience with Earned Value Management (EVM) and Work Breakdown Schedules (WBS). Experience in managing Sub-contractors (if Subcontracting is proposed). Experience with applying model-based system (MBSE) engineering principles and tools, translating program requirements and tracing data into technical plans and processes. Experience in the application of systems engineering methodologies in the federal Government, including demonstrated expertise implementing Department of Defense Architecture Framework (DoDAF) capabilities-based requirements processes.
Experience in Department of Defense (DoD) operational and mission planning, including the application of the Unified Joint Task List (UJTL), Joint Mission Essential Tasks (JMET), and Mission Essential Tasks (MET) in support of military requirements.
Experience working with the Navy, especially NSWC Dahlgren or similar organizations.
Occasional travel may be required to field sites for short, 1-2 week period of time.
Most travel would be in the United States, potential travel to outside the United States.

About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, Public Sector, you’ll work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, across US federal agencies and state, local and education (SLED) organizations. Your mission is to turn mission needs, legacy workflows and complex stakeholder dynamics into a clear picture of the most important problem, what the product needs, and where the impact is.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

Work with agency leaders, program offices, prime contractors, state and municipal departments, and school and university systems to find the highest-impact opportunities for AI agents in citizen- and student-facing and operational workflows (e.g. benefits and licensing, 311 and contact centers, case management, admissions and student services, internal service desks).
Own flagship deals end-to-end: identify the use case, shape the commercial structure alongside GTM and contracts partners, and navigate public sector procurement paths (federal contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, RFPs) through to close.
Embed with customer teams, including time onsite (in secure facilities for federal work), and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.
Guide customers on agent design, orchestration, and production readiness, including the security, privacy and compliance requirements specific to each segment, to get agents live and adopted.
Partner with Forward Deployed Software Engineers and Solution Engineers to build and demo solutions, present to audiences from technical teams to agency heads and elected or appointed officials, and feed field insights back to Product and Research.

Requirements

U.S. citizenship and an active U.S. government security clearance for federal engagements.
3+ years in a customer-facing technical role with government agencies, a public sector systems integrator, or a government-focused technology company.
Familiarity with public sector buying and compliance (e.g. GSA schedules, OTAs, FedRAMP and ATO processes, state cooperative contracts, state-level security frameworks, FERPA/CJIS/HIPAA where relevant) and comfort in deal conversations and long enterprise sales cycles with GTM partners.
Basic Python and API integration skills, enough to prototype, demo and talk credibly with engineering teams, plus familiarity with LLM and AI agent frameworks.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a track record of owning ambiguous, complex projects through to delivery.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States. There is a preference for candidates to be based in Washington, DC. Expect regular travel for customer onsites.

Your mission is to move beyond "reactive" automation. You will build the data pipelines and machine learning models that allow our Agentic Interfaces to anticipate user needs, recognise patterns of life, and provide a truly predictive, personalised experience. You will be the bridge between raw IoT data and the "brain" of our autonomous systems.

Key Responsibilities

Data Lake Management & Engineering
Architect and maintain a high-performance Data Lake to ingest, store, and process massive streams of event data from smart home devices, sensors, and robotic units
Design robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ensure data integrity, low-latency availability, and high-quality inputs for model training
Implement advanced Data Vectorization and Chunking strategies to prepare unstructured data for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and long-term agent memory
Pattern Analysis & Inference Training
Develop and deploy Machine Learning models to identify behavioural patterns (e.g., user routines, occupancy trends, and environmental preferences)
Conduct Inference Training to refine how our agents "reason" about user journeys, moving from simple triggers to complex anticipatory actions
Perform deep-dive Event Analysis to identify anomalies, optimise system performance, and improve the reliability of autonomous robot behaviours
Predictive Intelligence & Personalisation
Build the logic that powers Predictive Automation: ensuring the home doesn't just react to a command, but anticipates the user's next move
Develop "User Journey" models that allow our Agentic Interfaces to provide proactive assistance (e.g., preparing a meeting room before the user arrives or adjusting home climate based on predicted activity)
Collaborate with the Robotics and AI Engineering teams to feed personalised "profiles" into the agentic workflows
Analytics & Visualisation
Create internal dashboards to monitor the "health" of our intelligence, tracking model accuracy, prediction success rates, and data flow bottlenecks
Translate complex data findings into actionable product insights for the engineering and design teams

Requirements

Technical Requirements

Data Engineering: SQL, Python (Expert), Spark/Flink, Data Lake Architecture
Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Inference Optimisation, Reinforcement Learning (basics)
Vector Databases: Pinecone, ChromaDB, or Weaviate (experience with Vectorization & Chunking)
Data Processing: DuckDB, Apache Parquet, Pandas, NumPy
AI Frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph (for RAG data prep), OpenAI API, Ollama
IoT & Telemetry: MQTT, Home Assistant Data Exports, Time-Series Analysis
Mathematics: Probability, Statistics, Linear Algebra (for model training)

Preferred Qualifications

Data Science Background: A degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
Predictive Modeling Experience: Proven experience building models that predict human behaviour or time-series events
RAG Expertise: Deep understanding of how to chunk and vectorise data for Large Language Models (LLMs)
Agentic Mindset: An understanding of how "Agents" differ from standard "Automations", focusing on reasoning and planning rather than just If/Then logic

Why This Role?

You won't be cleaning spreadsheets; you will be building the Cognitive Layer of a modern home. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge data architectures and see your models directly influence how people interact with their physical environment. If you want to turn "Smart Homes" into "Intuitive Homes," this is your role.

Additional Suggestions For The Candidate

Portfolio Focus: We value candidates who can demonstrate a project involving time-series prediction, a custom RAG pipeline, or a complex data visualisation of IoT telemetry
Scalability Mindset: As the business grows, so will our data. We need someone who thinks about how to scale data ingestion from 10 homes to 10,000
Privacy First: You must have a strong understanding of data privacy and how to anonymise/secure sensitive user telemetry while still maintaining high-utility data for ML training

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive Tax-Free Salary: A market-leading monthly package in AED, commensurate with experience
Performance Incentives: Rewards linked to quality and delivery outcomes, as per Company Internal Policy
Visa & Medical Insurance: Full UAE visa sponsorship and comprehensive health cover
Paid Leave: As per Company Internal Policy and UAE Labour Law
Annual Flight Ticket & End-of-Service Gratuity: As per UAE market practice and Labour Law
Modern Tooling: Modern hardware plus cloud data and machine learning tools
Learning & Career Growth: Certification and conference support, with a clear path to leadership
Autonomy & Impact: Build the intelligence layer from the ground up and shape how AI is deployed in the physical world

jobs.description:
Company

Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland’s mission is to foster the stability, integrity, and efficiency of the nation’s monetary, financial, and payment systems while representing the Fourth District perspectives.

As part of the nation’s central bank, we are a team of mission-driven professionals who are committed to serving with excellence. Our core values are: Build Trust Every Day, Own Our Actions, Collaborate with Intention, and Be Open to Change.

For twenty-seven years in a row, we’ve been named “One of Northeast Ohio’s Best Places to Work” by North Coast 99. This prestigious award honors organizations with outstanding employment practices, including compensation, benefits, training, recruitment, retention, community services, and employee communications.

Follow us on LinkedIn, Twitter, Instagram, and our YouTube channel – Cleveland Fed

Conducts advanced analysis and policy directed research that contributes to internal publications, external publications, policy advising, and outreach. As part of a multidisciplinary and collaborative team of researchers and professionals, you will work in all areas of policy advising and support directly for the Bank President and senior Bank principles. We are part of the Executive function.

The Senior Policy analyst will analyze and research on issues that affect financial markets and monetary policy across a broad range of topic areas, expanding the bank’s capabilities to monitor and assess the impacts of market developments and functioning on policy. You will use database knowledge to compile statistical data, create data exploration tools, conduct initial data exploration on your own and work with senior staff members on their research. This is an outstanding opportunity for someone who is highly motivated to learn about monetary policy and financial markets, while contributing to impactful work directly connected to the key policy making responsibilities of the Federal Reserve.

Essential Accountabilities

Support team deliverables to advise Reserve Bank President, other senior Bank leaders, and the public on matters related to financial markets and monetary policy through published reports and presentations.
Develop and maintain materials and tools to educate internal and external stakeholders on key issues affecting financial markets, market functioning, and monetary policy.
Support in the writing and editing of speeches for the Reserve Bank President and other principles.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with financial industry leaders, as well as key stakeholders across the Federal Reserve System to advance Bank-level objectives
Conducts advanced directed research and analysis for internal and external publications and presentations.
Leads the recruitment and training of new team members.
Attends department seminars and training sessions to enhance economic knowledge and develop technical skills.
Performs other duties as assigned or requested.

Education And Experience

Bachelor's Degree in finance, economics, mathematics, statistics, computer science, or related field.
3-5 years of as an analyst in financial industry, regulatory agency, or academic institution.

Knowledge Areas – Advanced:

Knowledge of finance, monetary policy, macroeconomics, or other related fields.

Skill Areas – Advanced:

Strong analytical, quantitative, and specialized technical skills
Strong ability to conduct policy analysis and research with minimal oversight
Strong ability to analyze complex and large data sets using statistical packages or standard programming languages
Strong ability to balance multiple projects and deadlines
Oral and written communication skills
Ability to innovate and commitment to public service

Location: Cleveland, OH

The expected starting salary range for the Research Analyst Senior is between $83,600 and $105,000 annually. Final salary and offer will be determined by the applicant’s background, experience, skills, internal equity, and market data.

The Cleveland Fed offers benefits to support overall health and financial security. Learn more about our benefits here:
https://www.clevelandfed.org/careers

Citizenship requirement

You must be either a U.S citizen or Permanent Resident to apply. In addition, all candidates must undergo an enhanced background check and comply with all applicable information handling rules, and all non-U.S. citizens must sign a declaration of intent to become a U.S. citizen and pursue a path to citizenship.

Physical Demands and General Working Conditions

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, standards or requirements, efforts, skills or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, the Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland reserves the right to revise this or any job description at any time.

-
The Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland is committed to ensuring that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. To request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please send an email to clev.4d.benefits.specialist@clev.frb.org.

Bank’s Ethics Rules and Drug Testing
:

As a condition of employment, Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland employees must comply with the Bank’s ethics rules which generally prohibit employees, their spouses/domestic partners, and minor children from owning or controlling, directly or indirectly, any debt or equity interest in a depository institution or an affiliate of a depository institution. A "depository institution" means a bank, a trust company, or any institution that accepts deposits, including a bank chartered under the laws of a foreign country. In addition, employees (and their spouses/domestic partners, and minor children) may not own shares of mutual funds, unit investment trusts or ETFs that have a policy, as stated in the prospectus, of concentrating in the financial services industry and that have underlying investments in banks or other depository institutions. If you or your spouse/domestic partner or minor child own such securities and would not be willing or able to divest them if you accepted an offer of Bank employment, you should raise this issue with the recruiter for this posting.

In addition, as a condition of employment, candidates must undergo a background check and will be tested for all controlled substances prohibited by federal law, to include marijuana, prior to hire and for certain safety sensitive positions during employment.

is seeking an accomplished Senior
Program Analyst
to provide senior-level program analysis and decision support for Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division mission assurance activities. The Program Analyst will integrate technical findings, assessment results, schedules, resources, staffing information, risks, dependencies, and organizational priorities into accurate, traceable, and decision-ready products for Government leadership and supported program offices. Integrate technical, schedule, staffing, risk, resource, and performance information into decision-ready analyses and leadership briefings.

jobs.title: Data Analyst - Institutional Research
jobs.description:
Title:
Data Analyst - Institutional Research

Employee Classification:
Other Professionals

Institution:
Roane State Community College

Department:
Institutional Research

Campus Location:
Roane State Community College

Job Summary

The IR Data Analyst develops data solutions that help Roane State Community College understand student outcomes, improve institutional operations, and make informed decisions. The position combines data analysis, business intelligence development, programming, and institutional research. The analyst develops data models, dashboards, reports, database queries, and analytical tools; conducts research and statistical analyses; and supports institutional, state, and federal reporting.

We are seeking candidates with strong analytical and technical skills who can translate complex questions into effective data solutions. Successful candidates may come from backgrounds in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, institutional research, computer science, statistics, social science research, or related fields.

This position may have the opportunity to work remotely within the state of Tennessee, with periodic visits to Roane State Community College Harriman Campus (Harriman, TN) at the employee’s expense, and potential travel to TBR colleges in Tennessee.

Job Duties

Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Development

Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, data models, reports, and other analytical tools that support institutional decision-making and operational effectiveness.
Develop database queries and programs to extract, transform, integrate, analyze, and present institutional data.
Collaborate with users to define business, research, and reporting needs and translate those needs into effective technical solutions.
Develop, test, document, maintain, and enhance applications and analytical products as institutional needs change.
Create clear, accessible visualizations and interfaces that communicate complex information to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Institutional Research and Reporting

Conduct research and analyze data for internal and external information requests, institutional projects, planning, and evaluation.
Apply appropriate research designs and statistical methods when developing analyses, surveys, data products, and reports.
Create and query databases, conduct descriptive and inferential analyses, and develop surveys to support institutional research and evaluation.
Prepare and validate data used for required state and federal reporting and assist with data-quality and compliance processes.
Respond to requests for institutional information and communicate findings, limitations, and implications to College stakeholders and external agencies.
Support grant development and reporting through data analysis and evaluation support.

Institutional and Technical Support

Manage the technical and logistical processes associated with student evaluations of faculty, including scheduling, troubleshooting, data processing, and distribution of results.
Develop and maintain web-based tools and content used to communicate institutional information.
Collaborate closely with the Director of Institutional Research and other College personnel on research, reporting, analytics, and data-development projects.
Participate in professional development, meetings, and College committees as requested.
Performs other duties as assigned in support of Institutional Research operations and the College’s mission.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, computer science, information systems, social science, business, public administration, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and 5 years of experience working in a related field. Experience working with databases and analyzing complex data.
Working knowledge of at least one analytical or programming language such as SQL, DAX, SAS, R, Python, or a comparable language.
Understanding of quantitative research methods, including research design and statistical analysis.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
Ability to exercise discretion and appropriately handle sensitive institutional data.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing dashboards and analytical solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable business intelligence platform. Intermediate to advanced proficiency in SQL or another database query language.
Experience with one or more analytical or programming languages such as DAX, R, Python, SAS, or comparable tools.
Experience with data modeling, data transformation, database design, or development of data marts.
Experience conducting statistical analyses or applying quantitative research methods.
Experience working with higher education, government, or other complex administrative data.
Experience communicating analytical findings to nontechnical audiences.
Graduate education in a relevant quantitative, technical, social science, or research-oriented field.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ability to translate business and research questions into appropriate data models, analyses, dashboards, and technical solutions.
Knowledge of relational databases, data cleaning, data transformation, data validation, and analytical workflows.
Knowledge of quantitative research design, descriptive and inferential statistics, and responsible interpretation of findings.
Ability to evaluate data limitations and communicate conclusions without overstating what the evidence supports.
Ability to learn new analytical tools, programming languages, and data systems as institutional needs evolve.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with faculty, staff, administrators, and technical personnel.

In order to be considered for the position, the following items must be uploaded:

Application
Resume
3 professional references

Incomplete applications will not be considered.
