About the Role

Milestone is seeking an experienced Business Systems Analyst III (BSA III) to support an enterprise Learning Management System (LMS) transformation project, including the migration from SumTotal LMS to SAP SuccessFactors Learning.

In this role, you will work with business stakeholders, Learning & Development, Human Resources, Compliance, Quality, Information Technology, and implementation partners. You will gather and document business requirements, analyze existing processes, support data migration, coordinate testing, and help prepare the new learning platform for deployment.

You will help ensure the future-state LMS meets business, operational, and compliance requirements while maintaining GxP and training compliance standards.

Key Responsibilities

Elicit, document, analyze, and manage business requirements for the LMS transformation program.
Conduct stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process review sessions.
Work with business and technical teams to define future-state learning processes and system capabilities.
Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, process flows, and use cases.
Maintain traceability between business requirements, system configuration, testing activities, and deployment deliverables.
Facilitate reviews and approvals of business requirements documentation.
Analyze current learning management processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
Document current-state and future-state workflows.
Evaluate training administration, curriculum management, learner assignments, qualification tracking, reporting, and compliance processes.
Support process harmonization and standardization, identify business process gaps, and recommend solutions.
Support migration from SumTotal LMS to SAP SuccessFactors Learning.
Analyze training and curriculum data for migration readiness and assist with data mapping, transformation, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.
Document business rules for training records and learning assignments.
Validate migrated data against approved requirements and business expectations.
Coordinate data review and signoff activities with business stakeholders.
Collaborate with implementation teams to define system requirements and configuration needs.
Participate in design workshops, solution reviews, defect triage, and issue resolution.
Review proposed configurations against business requirements and compliance needs.
Document functional specifications and configuration requirements.
Support GxP-regulated system implementation activities and assist with Computer System Validation (CSV) documentation and reviews.
Contribute to validation deliverables, including User Requirements Specifications (URS), functional requirements, traceability matrices, test scenarios, and validation evidence.
Ensure compliance-related business requirements are documented and tested, and support audit readiness and documentation management.
Develop and coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities, including test scenarios, scripts, and test data requirements.
Coordinate testing schedules and stakeholder participation.
Track test execution, defects, resolutions, and retesting activities.
Facilitate business validation and acceptance of system functionality.
Support deployment readiness assessments.
Gather and document reporting requirements for dashboards, training compliance reports, and operational reporting.
Validate reporting outputs and analytics requirements against regulatory and operational objectives.
Act as a liaison between business users, project teams, technical teams, and implementation partners.
Build working relationships across HR, Learning & Development, Compliance, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and IT teams.
Support change management and organizational readiness activities, including end-user communications and training materials.

Required Experience

Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and SumTotal is required.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist, Public Sector (Federal & SLED) - North America
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We Have Expanded From Voice Into Three Main Platforms

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About The Role

As a Deployment Strategist, Public Sector, you’ll work alongside Forward Deployed Engineers, Go to Market professionals, Product Engineers and other Strategists to deploy ElevenAgents, our enterprise AI platform, across US federal agencies and state, local and education (SLED) organizations. Your mission is to turn mission needs, legacy workflows and complex stakeholder dynamics into a clear picture of the most important problem, what the product needs, and where the impact is.

No two days are the same, but as a Deployment Strategist you can expect to:

Work with agency leaders, program offices, prime contractors, state and municipal departments, and school and university systems to find the highest-impact opportunities for AI agents in citizen- and student-facing and operational workflows (e.g. benefits and licensing, 311 and contact centers, case management, admissions and student services, internal service desks).
Own flagship deals end-to-end: identify the use case, shape the commercial structure alongside GTM and contracts partners, and navigate public sector procurement paths (federal contract vehicles, cooperative contracts, RFPs) through to close.
Embed with customer teams, including time onsite (in secure facilities for federal work), and own delivery outcomes as if you were part of their team.
Guide customers on agent design, orchestration, and production readiness, including the security, privacy and compliance requirements specific to each segment, to get agents live and adopted.
Partner with Forward Deployed Software Engineers and Solution Engineers to build and demo solutions, present to audiences from technical teams to agency heads and elected or appointed officials, and feed field insights back to Product and Research.

Requirements

U.S. citizenship and an active U.S. government security clearance for federal engagements.
3+ years in a customer-facing technical role with government agencies, a public sector systems integrator, or a government-focused technology company.
Familiarity with public sector buying and compliance (e.g. GSA schedules, OTAs, FedRAMP and ATO processes, state cooperative contracts, state-level security frameworks, FERPA/CJIS/HIPAA where relevant) and comfort in deal conversations and long enterprise sales cycles with GTM partners.
Basic Python and API integration skills, enough to prototype, demo and talk credibly with engineering teams, plus familiarity with LLM and AI agent frameworks.
Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with a track record of owning ambiguous, complex projects through to delivery.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States. There is a preference for candidates to be based in Washington, DC. Expect regular travel for customer onsites.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager – Quantum & Advanced Tech R&D
jobs.description:
Quandela Is a Global Leader In Quantum Computing, Designing, Building, And Delivering Cutting-edge Quantum Solutions For Research And Industry. Its Offerings Include The Most Energy-efficient Quantum Computers For Data Centers, Full-stack Quantum Computing Solutions Accessible Via The Cloud, And Algorithm Access Services For Academic And Industrial Customers. Following a Pragmatic, Step-by-step Roadmap, Quandela Has Been Deploying Industrial-grade Systems Since 2023 While Developing Future Generations Of Fault-tolerant Quantum Computers Capable Of Scaling Through The Integration Of Thousands Of Photonic Components. Quandela Is Committed To Making Quantum Computing Accessible To All In Order To Address The Most Complex Industrial And Societal Challenges. Learn More At

Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced

Senior Project Manager – Advanced Technology Programs

to lead large-scale, strategic technology and R&D programs involving multiple technical disciplines, internal teams and external partners.

You will operate at the intersection of

technology, engineering and program execution , turning ambitious technical objectives into structured and executable programs.

You will coordinate programs involving disciplines such as

quantum physics, integrated photonics, semiconductor technologies, electronics, optics, hardware engineering, software and algorithms , while ensuring alignment between technical performance, schedule, resources, budget and contractual commitments.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed

large and technically complex programs in demanding engineering environments such as space, aerospace, defense or semiconductors , where successful delivery requires coordinating multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, industrial partners, research organizations and institutional stakeholders across several countries.

This is a senior individual contributor / program leadership position requiring both

technical credibility and strong execution capabilities . You will not be expected to be the scientific expert on every topic, but you must be able to understand complex technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, structure decisions and create the conditions for engineering teams to deliver.

Key responsabilities

Lead Complex Technology Projects

Take end-to-end ownership of strategic R&D and technology projects, from initial framing through development, integration, validation and final delivery.

Translate high-level scientific, product or business ambitions into

clear program objectives, work packages, milestones, interfaces and measurable deliverables .

Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, dependencies and critical paths.

Establish program governance and ensure effective decision-making across technical teams and senior stakeholders.

Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify deviations, bottlenecks and dependencies requiring management attention.

Drive recovery plans when projects deviate from their original objectives, including prioritization, resource reallocation, scope adjustment or technical replanning.

Manage Technical complexity & interfaces

Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning

quantum physics, photonics, semiconductor technologies, optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, software and algorithms .

Work closely with technical leads to identify critical interfaces and dependencies between subsystems and workstreams.

Challenge project assumptions and ensure that technical decisions are translated into clear consequences for

performance, schedule, cost and risk .

Support the transition from

research and scientific proof-of-concept to engineering development, prototyping, integration, qualification and demonstrators .

Ensure that technical maturity, integration readiness and project risks are visible and understood at program level.

* Coordinate Internal & External Stakeholders

Act as a central coordination point between Quandela teams, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions and institutional stakeholders.

Lead technical and programmatic exchanges involving stakeholders with different scientific, engineering and business perspectives.

Coordinate activities across

multiple teams, organizations, sites and countries , ensuring clear ownership and effective information flow.

Manage expectations and commitments with external partners while protecting Quandela's technical, contractual and strategic interests.

Prepare and lead program reviews, steering committees and executive-level project updates.

**

Risk, Budget & Delivery Management

Establish and maintain structured

risk and opportunity management , including technical, schedule, supply-chain, financial and organizational risks.

Own or contribute to program budgets, resource forecasts and capacity planning.

Define and monitor relevant KPIs covering delivery, technical maturity, cost, schedule and risk.

Anticipate critical-path issues and implement mitigation plans before they impact major milestones.

Create a strong culture of

accountability, transparency and fact-based decision-making

across programs.

Governance, contracts & compliance

Ensure high-quality program documentation, traceability and reporting. Coordinate contractual deliverables and reporting for strategic partnerships and publicly funded programs where applicable.

Work with relevant internal stakeholders on

IP, confidentiality, export-control, security and contractual matters .

Contribute to improving Quandela's project and program management methodologies as the organization scales.

Education

You have graduated from a

top-tier engineering school or university

in engineering, physics or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.

A

PhD in physics, photonics, quantum technologies, semiconductor technologies or a related engineering field is a strong asset , particularly when combined with substantial industrial program-management experience.

Experience

You bring approximately

10+ years of professional experience , including significant responsibility for complex technology or engineering programs.

You have demonstrated experience leading

large-scale, multidisciplinary projects

with significant technical complexity, multiple interfaces and demanding delivery objectives.

Experience in one or several of the following industries is particularly relevant:

Space / aerospace

Defense

Semiconductors / microelectronics

Advanced photonics or optics

Complex scientific instrumentation

Other high-tech environments combining hardware, software and advanced engineering

You have worked with

multidisciplinary and international stakeholders , including engineering teams, scientists, suppliers, industrial partners, research institutions and/or public organizations.

You can demonstrate concrete examples of programs for which you managed significant

scope, budget, resources, milestones, risks and external dependencies .

Technical & Program Management Capabilities

You have sufficient technical depth to understand complex engineering discussions, challenge project assumptions and identify critical technical dependencies without replacing subject-matter experts.

You are comfortable managing projects from

early-stage R&D through engineering development, prototyping, integration and validation .

You have strong command of project/program management practices including

WBS, planning, critical-path management, risk management, resource planning, budget management, change management and project governance .

Experience with PMI/PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or hybrid methodologies is valued, but

demonstrated delivery experience matters more than certification alone.

Experience with publicly funded, governmental or collaborative R&D programs is an advantage.

Previous quantum-computing experience is

not mandatory . Experience in quantum technologies, photonics or semiconductor technologies would nevertheless be a strong asset.

Leadership & Mindset

You combine a strong engineering mindset with the ability to operate at program and strategic level. You are comfortable challenging senior technical stakeholders while maintaining constructive and fact-based discussions.

You know how to bring structure to environments where

technical uncertainty is high and not all answers are available at the beginning of a project .

You can distinguish between issues requiring deep technical investigation and those requiring pragmatic decisions to maintain momentum.

You communicate effectively with both highly specialized technical teams and executive stakeholders.

You are comfortable operating in an

international, multidisciplinary and rapidly growing deeptech environment .

Professional fluency in English is required.

Flexible working environment, with the position primarily based at our Massy (Paris-Saclay) offices to support close collaboration with the teams.

Profit-sharing and a company savings plan.

Beyond That

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive
. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery
and minimally invasive care
, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system
and Ion
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare
, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary function of position

The Technical Program Manager for Country-Specific Labeling (CSL) owns end-to-end delivery and long-term support of Intuitive’s custom CSL system, from architecture and design through implementation and at sites throughout the world and manage continuous improvements and feature enhancements. You will translate multi-country Regulatory Affairs requirements into scalable system requirements, labeling schemas, and templates, and drive integration with SAP and warehouse management systems. You will lead cross-functional execution across IT, Quality, Regulatory, warehouse logistics, and label suppliers, including UAT planning and go-live readiness, to ensure compliant and efficient labeling. This role sits within Technical Services, reporting to the Product Labeling & Packaging Operations Manager.

Roles And Responsibilities

Essential duties

Own the end-to-end CSL program, serving as the primary driver for planning, execution, delivery, and stakeholder alignment across RA, IT, Quality, Operations, suppliers, and logistics sites.
Lead Country-Specific Labeling requirements management, partnering with Regulatory Affairs (RA/RSAs) to interpret country regulatory assessments and convert them into clear, testable requirements.
Drive schema development with IT/engineering teams by defining requirements, acceptance criteria, traceability, and change impacts; ensure schemas are scalable and aligned to enterprise standards.
Lead integration delivery for labeling capabilities with SAP and warehouse management systems, coordinating dependencies, interface readiness, and cutover planning.
Coordinate with warehouse logistics teams and external partners to implement labeling workflows, including label printing/handling, verification steps, exception management, and training/readiness.
Facilitate label template design discussions to ensure templates work as expected across countries, products, printer constraints, and warehouse execution.
Manage workstreams related to supplier-printed labels, including specifications alignment, readiness tracking, issue triage, and operational deployment coordination.
Define and structure User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for labeling (test strategy, test cases, traceability, execution coordination, defect management, and sign-off).
Partner with Quality to manage labeling-related non-conformances (NCs) and CAPAs, supporting investigation coordination, corrective action execution, and effectiveness checks.
Establish and maintain program documentation (program plans, RAID logs, requirements traceability, SOP/work instructions impacts, release notes) and drive standardization of CSL delivery processes.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce labeling errors, shorten cycle times, improve audit readiness, and strengthen operational controls.

Qualifications

Education, experience, skills and training

Education And Experience

Minimum of bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field.
Minimum of 8+ years of experience working in labeling, hardware, system production, or test environment primarily in healthcare industry.

Technical Skills

Lead technical, cross-functional programs end-to-end (requirements → build/config → testing → deployment) in a regulated and/or operationally complex environment.
Strong ability to translate regulatory labeling requirements into system requirements, schemas, templates, and warehouse-operational processes.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate across RA, IT/engineering, Quality, warehouse operations/logistics, suppliers, and external partners (3PLs).
Hands-on experience running UAT (planning, traceability, execution coordination, defect triage, and release readiness).
Experience building and maintaining enterprise program artifacts: requirements traceability, release governance, cutover plans, training/readiness, and stakeholder reporting.

Other Skills And Abilities

Able to learn and apply established procedures in a reliable and consistent manner.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal) with the ability to drive alignment, decisions, and execution across multiple stakeholders.
Ability to lead and deliver in a matrix environment.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to be self-managed in a fast-paced environment utilizing agile/sprint methodologies.
Quick learner with ability to understand complex products and processes.
Ability to work in a team environment.
High level of attention to technical details and accuracy.
Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision
Ability to multitask, and handle tasks with competing priorities effectively
Proficient with MS Office applications

Additional Information

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

Mandatory Notices

U.S. Export Controls Disclaimer: In accordance with the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (15 CFR

743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

For any Intuitive role subject to export controls, final offers are contingent upon obtaining an approved export license and/or an executed TCP prior to the prospective employee’s start date, which may or may not be flexible, and within a timeframe that does not unreasonably impede the hiring need. If applicable, candidates will be notified and instructed on any requirements for these purposes.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with fair chance laws.

Preference will be given to qualified candidates who do not reside, or plan to reside, in Alabama, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Iowa, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, Missouri, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, or Tennessee.

business need and/or on the selected candidate’s experience, knowledge and skills.

Compensation will be based primarily on the job level at which the role is filled and the

Candidate’s Qualifications, Consistent With Applicable Law.

We provide solutions to agencies and entities including the Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of Defense, Defense Logistics Agency, National Institutes of Health, and more. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. Our Mission, Vision, and Values guide the way we do business.

If this sounds like an environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

Tokiye Integrated Medical Services (TIMS) Ltd is a premier health systems development and management company based in Nigeria, with over 15 years of experience in healthcare project development and management. The organization focuses on problem-driven healthcare solutions for both public and private sector clients, supporting sustainable improvements in health service delivery. TIMS is fully indigenous and leverages local knowledge to design and implement context-appropriate interventions. With a multidisciplinary team whose expertise spans clinical care, project management, financing, and healthcare operations, and a combined experience of over 100 years, TIMS positions itself as a catalyst for enhanced healthcare value across Africa.

Role Description

The Programme Manager will lead and provide strategic and operational leadership for the organisation’s programmes supporting vulnerable women, children and families.
The role is responsible for identifying and assessing beneficiaries, developing measurable and cost-effective intervention plans, securing Board approvals, coordinating programme delivery, monitoring outcomes and reporting on impact. The Programme Manager will also establish and manage partnerships, oversee programme budgets, ensure safeguarding compliance and build a growing programme team as the organisation expands.

Key Responsibilities

1. Beneficiary Identification and Assessment

Receive and document cases from all referral channels, including field activities, community leaders, partners and Board members.
Record referral sources and any declared relationships or connections to beneficiaries
Screen applications against the organisation’s eligibility criteria within one week.
Conduct beneficiary verification through field visits and document reviews within three weeks.
Ensure consistent, transparent and impartial assessment of all cases.
Establish each beneficiary’s baseline circumstances and define measurable, achievable support outcomes.

2. Program Planning and Approval

Develop individual beneficiary support plans with clearly defined objectives, timelines, cost estimates, payment schedules, risks and follow-up arrangements.
Document beneficiaries’ pay-it-forward commitments as part of approved support plans.
Present cases and programme recommendations to the Board for approval.
Obtain further approval for significant changes to previously approved support plans.
Apply the organisation’s emergency approval procedure where immediate intervention is required, ensuring that all supporting documentation is completed afterwards.

3. Programme Budgeting and Financial Management

Prepare annual programme budgets, forecasts and funding requirements for Board approval.
Develop accurate cost estimates for individual interventions and recurring programmes.
Assess the value for money and financial implications of proposed interventions.
Monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets and promptly report variances, financial risks and emerging funding needs.
Approve programme running costs within delegated authority.
Prepare properly documented payment requests, referencing the relevant beneficiary case number or budget line.
Work closely with the Finance team on expenditure reconciliations, financial reporting and audits.
Ensure that all programme expenditure is supported by complete and accurate documentation.

4. Programme Implementation and Monitoring

Coordinate the delivery of approved interventions, directly or through qualified service providers and partners.
Where practicable, make payments directly to service providers such as schools, hospitals, landlords and suppliers rather than to individual beneficiaries.
Conduct beneficiary follow-ups at one, three and six months, with formal closeout assessments at approximately twelve months.
Evaluate whether intended outcomes have been achieved and document lessons learned.
Monitor beneficiaries’ compliance with agreed pay-it-forward commitments.
Maintain appropriate photographs, videos and case notes in accordance with the organisation’s consent, confidentiality and dignity standards.

5. Programme Development and Partnership Management

Coordinate approved recurring programmes, ensuring that beneficiaries are enrolled in line with established eligibility criteria.
Maintain accurate programme registers and implementation records.
Prepare quarterly programme performance reports and recommendations for annual programme renewal.
Identify, assess and establish relationships with potential implementation partners across relevant states.
Conduct partner due diligence, including verification of registration, financial records, leadership, safeguarding practices and operational capacity.
Conduct site visits before formalising partnerships.
Develop and manage written partnership agreements and monitor partner performance against agreed deliverables.

6. Safeguarding and Risk Management

Ensure strict adherence to the organisation’s safeguarding policies and code of conduct when working with children and vulnerable adults.
Serve as Deputy Safeguarding Lead and ensure safeguarding concerns are promptly reported, documented and escalated.
Ensure that safeguarding concerns are acted upon within twenty-four hours in accordance with organisational procedures.
Identify programme delivery risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures.

7. Reporting, Impact Measurement and Team Leadership

Develop and submit regular reports to the Board covering programme outcomes, expenditure, budget performance, risks and implementation progress.
Establish appropriate monitoring and evaluation processes to measure programme effectiveness and beneficiary outcomes.
Recruit, supervise, mentor and develop programme staff as the organisation expands.
Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations and accountability within the programme team.
Promote a culture of integrity, professionalism, collaboration and accountability.

Qualifications

Essential
A degree or professional qualification in Social Work, Sociology, Community Development, Public Health or a related discipline.
At least five years’ relevant experience in social work, community development or NGO programme management.
Demonstrable experience working with vulnerable women, children and families.
Experience preparing, managing and monitoring programme budgets.
Good financial literacy and ability to assess intervention costs and value for money.
Strong documentation, case management and report-writing skills.
Must be based in Port Harcourt and willing to travel within Nigeria.

Desirable Requirements
Knowledge of safeguarding principles and beneficiary case management practices.
Established relationships with NGOs, faith-based organisations and community-based organisations.
Experience establishing programmes, operational processes or systems within a new or growing organisation.
Good working knowledge of Rivers State and the wider South-South region.
Key Selflessness, compassion and commitment to serving vulnerable populations.
High integrity, discretion and impartiality.
Respect for the dignity, rights and confidentiality of beneficiaries.
Fairness and consistency in beneficiary selection and programme decisions.
A collaborative approach and willingness to support collective organisational decisions.
Reliability, accountability, self-motivation and strong organisational discipline.

Competencies and Skills

Programme planning, implementation and management.
Budgeting, financial monitoring and cost control.
Beneficiary assessment and case management.
Monitoring, evaluation and impact reporting.
Partnership development and stakeholder management.

new_jobs.description:
Archer
is collaborating with True Anomaly
to connect them with exceptional professionals for this role.

Space is a warfighting domain. True Anomaly seeks those with the talent and ambition to build the technology that secures it.

OUR MISSION

True Anomaly delivers decisive capabilities for space superiority. We build autonomous spacecraft, advanced payloads, mission software, and space-based interceptors — enabling the U.S. and its Allies to secure the space environment and counter threats from the ultimate high ground.

OUR VALUES

Be the offset. We create asymmetric advantages with creativity and ingenuity.
What would it take? We challenge assumptions to deliver ambitious results.
It’s the people. Our team is our competitive advantage and we are better together.

BENEFITS & PERKS*

Best-in-class healthcare: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents, with HSA/HRA options
Generous time off: Flexible Time Off (FTO) for exempt employees, accrued PTO of up to 25 days for non-exempt employees, plus 12 paid holidays; Parental Leave; Sick Leave
Fuel for your day: Daily catered lunch and unlimited snacks for in-office employees
And more: 401(k) retirement plan, fitness reimbursement, and Dog Fridays
Equity participation: Equity is included as part of our total compensation package, giving you an opportunity to share in the company’s success.
Do not apply to fixed term and temporary roles

YOUR MISSION

We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join the Security & Infrastructure PMO, dedicated to our Application Security and Platform Security teams in Long Beach. You will be the embedded program management partner to these two teams, driving execution from intake through delivery, running their operational rhythms, engaging with cross-functional software engineering teams, and keeping leadership's view of commitments and risk current and honest.

Application Security owns the security of the software we build: secure development practices, product and application security programs, vulnerability management, and the controls that keep our codebase and pipelines defensible. Platform Security owns the security of the environments that software runs in: cloud and platform security, identity and access management, infrastructure hardening, and the operational processes that keep those domains healthy. Your job is to make both teams more predictable and more effective—turning technical work into tracked, milestone-oriented programs and surfacing conflicts before they become delivery problems. It is also part engagement manager and part product manager: the company's software engineering teams are App Security and Platform Security's customers, and you help understand their needs and shape how security capabilities are delivered back to them.

This is a dedicated role, but not a static one. Your primary charter is Application Security and Platform Security, and that is where you'll build the deepest context. As portfolio priorities shift, you should expect to flex across other Security & Infrastructure programs when the PMO needs it, bringing the same execution rigor wherever you're pointed.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end delivery for Application Security and Platform Security initiatives—building and maintaining the program plans, milestone schedules, and dependency maps in Jira, and driving them from intake through close
Run both teams' operational cadences—sprint/backlog grooming, weekly status, and quarterly planning—and keep backlog health and ticket hygiene good enough that status is trustworthy without a fire drill
Partner with the team leads on effort estimation, task decomposition, and resource alignment across concurrent workstreams; surface capacity conflicts and schedule risk early, with options
Serve the software engineering teams as the primary customers of App Security and Platform Security—intake their requests, set expectations on what security can deliver and when, and keep that channel active rather than reactive
Manage cross-functional dependencies with software engineering, IT, GRC, cloud/platform, and external vendors and assessors
Produce leadership-ready program visibility—milestone-oriented, risk-flagged, and current—including the roll-ups and tear-sheets the PMO uses for steering
Partner with the PMO Lead on roadmap planning: prioritization, capacity planning, and keeping the plan of record maintained as priorities shift
Flex to other Security & Infrastructure programs as portfolio demand requires, bringing the same execution discipline to an unfamiliar domain

Qualifications

10+ years combining application and platform security with the technical program management of that work—deep in at least one domain (secure SDLC, vulnerability management, CI/CD pipeline security; cloud and infrastructure security, identity and access management), credible in the other, with a track record of owning and running programs end to end
Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent workstreams with cross-functional dependencies and external stakeholders
Strong Jira or equivalent proficiency; able to build and maintain structured tracking across multi-team portfolios
Comfortable operating where scope, priorities, and assignments shift with portfolio demand
Clear, direct communicator; able to simplify complex status for executive audiences and push back when warranted
U.S. citizenship required; clearable required

Preferred Skills And Experience

Prior experience as an information security engineer who has since moved into technical program management (preferred over a TPM background without hands-on security experience)
Familiarity working directly with software engineering and platform/DevOps teams
Familiarity with NIST RMF, FedRAMP, or federal compliance environments
Experience in defense technology, aerospace, or DoD contractor environments

Compensation

Base Salary: $140,000-$210,000
Equity + Benefits including Health, Dental, Vision, HRA/HSA options, PTO and paid holidays, 401K, Parental Leave

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, location, and experience.

Additional Requirements

Work Location—Successful candidates will be located near Long Beach. While we observe a hybrid work environment, some work must be done on site.
Work environment—the work environment; temperature, noise level, inside or outside, or other factors that will affect the person's working conditions while performing the job.
Physical demands—the physical demands of the job, including bending, sitting, lifting and driving.

This position will be open until it is successfully filled. To submit your application, please follow the directions below.

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State.

new_jobs.description:
Job Type

Full-time

Description

The Program Manager is a leadership position responsible for the overall quality, compliance, growth, and sustainability of assigned substance use disorder programs, with a specific emphasis on the development, integration, and expansion of hospital outreach and peer-delivered services. This role provides strategic oversight of hospital outreach services, peer-delivered recovery support services, and all SUD housing programs located within Crook, Deschutes, and Jefferson Counties.

The Program Manager provides program-wide leadership, including clinical oversight, personnel management, peer workforce development, regulatory compliance, fiscal stewardship, and community partnership building. A central focus of this role is to build, train, support, and expand a robust outpatient peer workforce that complements clinical services, enhances engagement, and improves outcomes for individuals seeking recovery services. The Program Manager ensures peer services are delivered in alignment with trauma-informed, harm-reduction, and recovery-based principles while meeting all applicable Oregon Administrative Rules and organizational standards.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor degree behavioral health field preferred plus three (3) years of paid, full-time SUD experience, including at least one (1) year in an administrative or supervisory role; or field plus four (4) years of paid, full-time SUD experience, including at least one (1) year in an administrative or supervisory role; or High School Diploma (or equivalent) plus (5) ears of paid, full-time SUD and withdrawal management experience, including at least one (1) year in a supervisory role.
Applicants who are in recovery from a substance use disorder must have maintained a minimum of two consecutive years of recovery at the time of hire.

Required Licenses And Certifications

Current CADC-II required
Must maintain a valid Oregon Driver License or ability to obtain one upon hire and be insurable under the organization’s auto liability coverage policy (minimum 21 years of age and with no Type A violations in the past 3 years, or three (3) or more Type B violations) and must have a reliable vehicle with adequate insurance to travel as needed.

Preferred Experience

Bilingual in English/Spanish is preferred.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Behavioral Health.

Experience supervising or developing peer support programs

Primary Job Duties

PROGRAM LEADERSHIP AND PEER SERVICES DEVELOPMENT

Provides overall leadership and accountability for program operations, service quality, peer program and staff performance, client outcomes, and regulatory compliance in Crook, Deschutes and Jefferson counties.
Hires, trains, supervises, evaluates, and manages the performance of assigned staff in accordance with BestCare policies and applicable employment law.
Fosters a recovery-oriented culture that values lived experience, promotes ethical practice, and supports effective collaboration across the company.
Leads the development and expansion of peer delivered services across SUD programs to provide accessibility, engagement and continuity of care.

HOUSING PROGRAM LEADERSHIP

Establish and implement housing program policies and procedures ensuring consistency across programs.
Provides direct supervision and support to housing program staff across Crook, Deschutes, and Jefferson Counties.
Maintains and coordinates an afterhours on call schedule to support housing residents and programs.

QUALITY MANAGEMENT, COMPLIANCE AND BEST PRACTICES

Ensures peer and clinical services meet evidence-based, recovery-oriented, and harm-reduction standards.
Oversees documentation practices to ensure peer notes and clinical records are timely, accurate, and compliant with Best Care and State requirements.
Leads and participates in Quality Management activities, including audits, corrective action planning, and outcome monitoring related to peer and clinical services.
Ensures compliance with HIPAA, 42 CFR, Oregon Statutes, and ethical guidelines specific to peer-delivered services.

CLINICAL OVERSIGHT AND INTEGRATED CARE

Ensures that peer services are fully integrated with clinical treatment teams and support coordinated, person-centered care.
Ensures clinical supervision meets or exceeds Oregon Administrative Rule requirements and that peer supervision is delivered in a manner that supports ethical practice and recovery principles.
Maintains working knowledge of clinical practices, documentation standards, crisis response, and integrated care models to effectively oversee peer and clinical service delivery.
Monitors documentation quality and service delivery standards.
Provides direct clinical services on a limited, as-needed basis to support program operations and continuity of care.

FISCAL OVERSIGHT AND PROGRAM SUSTAINABILITY

Serves as the primary fiscal steward for assigned programs, including peer service components.
Monitors budgets, revenues, and expenses, ensuring efficient use of resources and sustainability of peer services.
Oversees productivity and utilization of peer staff and clinical staff, using data to inform staffing models and program expansion.
Identifies funding opportunities, grants, and partnerships that support the growth and sustainability of peer services.

COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIP AND ADVOCACY

Develops and maintains strong partnerships with community organizations, healthcare providers, and recovery networks to expand access to peer services across Crook, Deschutes and Jefferson counties.
Represents BestCare in community forums, coalitions, and planning efforts related to peer services and recovery-oriented systems of care.
Promotes awareness and acceptance of peer-delivered services within the community and among partner organizations.

Administrative And Operational Responsibilities

Collaborates with administrative and front office staff to support efficient and compliant operations.
Participates in leadership on-call rotation and remains accessible for consultation and decision-making support.
Performs other related duties as assigned by the Regional Program Director.

new_jobs.title: IT Project Manager (Business Applications)
new_jobs.description:
Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living.

Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come.

Job Purpose And Impact

The Project Manager supports the Digital Technology and Data (DT&D) team for Cargill’s Animal Nutrition & Health (ANH) business across the EMEAI & Global Salmon region. The role’s immediate priority will be to lead the portfolio of projects supporting Cargill’s regional SAP S/4HANA deployment, coordinating work across all business applications affected by the program. The role leads planning and delivery of cross-functional digital and technology projects in support of regional business priorities. It translates agreed priorities into integrated plans, coordinates teams across countries and time zones within the region, and manages scope, schedule, cost, resources, risks, dependencies, and quality. It partners with regional business stakeholders, country teams, product and application owners, technical teams, and vendors to deliver outcomes with clear governance and timely visibility.

This is a temporary replacement role with an expected duration of up to 2 years. We offer a hybrid working model following the onboarding period.

Key Accountabilities

PROJECT PLANNING AND GOVERNANCE: Define project objectives, scope, deliverables, milestones, decision rights, and governance. Build and maintain integrated plans that connect workstreams, dependencies, resource needs, and business outcomes.
CROSS-COUNTRY DELIVERY: Coordinate project teams and workstreams across countries within the EMEAI & Global Salmon region, clarify responsibilities, establish working routines, and keep work aligned with approved regional priorities and delivery plans.
PROJECT CONTROLS AND REPORTING: Monitor progress, schedule, costs, staffing, risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and changes. Maintain accurate forecasts and provide concise, timely status reporting for project teams, sponsors, and leadership.
RISK AND ISSUE MANAGEMENT: Identify obstacles early, assess impact, develop mitigation or recovery actions, and resolve complex issues independently where appropriate. Escalate decisions and risks that require sponsor or leadership direction.
BUDGET AND RESOURCE COORDINATION: Work with project sponsors, product leaders, workstream owners, and functional managers to plan and track project funding, staffing, and capacity. Recommend corrective actions when delivery is at risk.
QUALITY AND DELIVERY READINESS: Coordinate requirements, acceptance criteria, quality reviews, testing, cutover, and readiness activities. Ensure project artifacts, decisions, and actions are documented and accessible.
VENDOR AND PARTNER COORDINATION: Coordinate vendor and partner deliverables, schedules, dependencies, and issue resolution as assigned; communicate performance concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
STAKEHOLDER COMMUNICATION: Build effective partnerships and tailor communications for regional, country, business, technical, and leadership audiences. Anticipate competing stakeholder needs and make decisions, trade-offs, and impacts clear.

Qualifications

Minimum qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in a related field and/or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of four years of related project management experience.
Experience planning and coordinating complex, cross-functional projects, including schedules, budgets, resources, risks, dependencies, and status reporting.
Ability to organize project teams, clarify accountabilities, manage competing priorities, and deliver through influence across countries within the EMEAI & Global Salmon region.
Ability to use AI tools effectively and responsibly to increase proficiency and productivity in the role.
English proficiency, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and speech with global business users, technical teams, and vendors.
Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% of the time, as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience delivering technology, enterprise application, ERP, manufacturing, or integration projects.
Experience coordinating projects across countries within the EMEAI & Global Salmon region and working with teams that have different local requirements.
Experience managing several interdependent initiatives or projects with significant cost, risk, or resource constraints.
Proficiency in one or more regional languages used across EMEAI & Global Salmon is a plus.

Benefits

Private healthcare.
My Benefits platform.
Lunch card.
Life insurance.
Opportunity to join the Employee Pension Program (PPE).
Working in an international environment.

Our Offer

We provide a fast paced stimulating international environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the largest and most solid private companies in the world.

We welcome applications from people with disabilities and are committed to providing an inclusive, accessible recruitment process and workplace. We encourage candidates to let us know if they require any accommodations during the recruitment or interview process so we can support them appropriately.

Interested? Then make sure to send us your CV and cover letter in English today:

Follow us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cargill

Cargill is committed to being an inclusive employer. Click here to find out more https://careers.cargill.com/diversity/

If something doesn't feel right or you have questions, don't hesitate to contact us. To learn more, visit our Notice on Fraudulent Job Offers.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Tharros
is seeking an accomplished Program Manager
to provide full accountability for the planning, execution, integration, and performance of mission assurance support for the Naval Surface Warfare Center Dahlgren Division
Strategic and Computing Systems Department. The Program Manager will serve as Tharros’ principal interface with Government leadership and will direct a multidisciplinary team supporting defense critical infrastructure analysis, mission dependency and risk assessment, infrastructure vulnerability identification, engineering analysis, and related cyberspace programs.

The Program Manager will translate Government priorities into executable staffing, technical, schedule, quality, security, travel, and deliverable plans while maintaining qualified personnel across Key and Non-Key positions. The successful candidate will anticipate and resolve performance risks, integrate contractor and subcontractor activities, ensure the technical accuracy and timely delivery of contract products, and maintain continuity across continental United States and outside continental United States assessment activities.

Responsibilities

Provide overall management and integration of task-order performance across mission assurance, critical infrastructure, assessment, analysis, engineering, and program-support activities.
Coordinate contract execution with Government leadership and supported program offices, including planning priorities, staffing, schedules, deliverables, risks, issues, and required decisions.
Manage personnel, subcontractor, travel, security, quality, and administrative activities needed to sustain performance across continental United States and outside continental United States work locations.
Align contractor activities with Government direction and the mission of identifying infrastructure vulnerabilities and assessing risk to mission execution.
Oversee preparation, review, quality control, and timely delivery of technical, management, and assessment products.
Monitor staffing against the Government labor mix and maintain qualified, cleared personnel for key and non-key positions.
Identify program risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and performance issues; develop mitigation actions and track them through closure.
Maintain effective coordination among analysts, engineers, infrastructure specialists, assessment personnel, and program-support staff.
Protect classified and controlled information and ensure personnel comply with applicable facility, personnel, and information-security requirements.
Support transition, continuity, and knowledge retention across the base period and option periods.

Exempt

Web Development Services

We are seeking a Technical Business Analyst (BA) with a strong coding background and Agile expertise to bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation. This role requires a mix of business analysis, software development knowledge, and Agile methodologies to ensure seamless collaboration between stakeholders, developers, and product teams. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in coding, system analysis, and translating business requirements into technical solutions.

Gather, analyze, and document business and technical requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
Work closely with developers, architects, and product managers to translate business needs into technical specifications.
Conduct gap analysis, impact assessments, and feasibility studies for new initiatives.

Assist with data analysis, validation, troubleshooting, and system testing activities.
Collaborate with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate outcomes, and support defect resolution.

Maintain understanding of enterprise applications, digital platforms, and integration patterns.
Work with APIs, databases, and system integrations to ensure technical feasibility.
Collaborate on test cases, debugging, and data validation when needed.
Agile & Project Management
Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure smooth Agile delivery.
Participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and backlog grooming.
Assist in prioritizing features and enhancements based on business value and technical complexity.
Support QA testing efforts by defining test cases, verifying results, and ensuring quality.
Coordinate and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), working with business stakeholders and development teams to validate solutions against business requirement.
Process Improvement & Documentation
Create and maintain technical documentation, process workflows, and user guides.
Identify process inefficiencies and recommend automation or system enhancements.
Ensure data-driven decision-making by analyzing trends, system usage, and performance metrics.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Healthcare Administration, or related field required or Associate degree with 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
5+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst, Software Developer, or similar hybrid role.
Coding background in Python, JavaScript, SQL, Angular, note.js, C# or similar programming languages.
Hands-on experience with databases, APIs, and system integrations.
Experience collaborating with SaaS application teams for both enhancements and support.
Deep understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) and experience working in Agile teams.
Familiarity or experience with databases, APIs, and system integrations.
Experience collaborating with SaaS application teams for integrating, enhancements and support.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language.
Demonstrated commitment to the company’s core values of integrity, adaptability, service-focused, accountability, curiosity, and community.

Knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, or other Agile tools.
Understanding of DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Understanding of UX/UI principles, wireframing, and prototyping tools.
Certifications such as Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PMI-PBA, CBAP, or Agile BA.

JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

Summary

As a member of the Data Analyst team, your primary responsibilities will be to identify, collect, process, and analyze datasets to help make informed business decisions. You will also assist with data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents.

Your Impact

Discover, acquire, explore, prepare, assess and maintain datasets from a variety of data sources (including external sources) to support analyses and ad-hoc investigative requests for project and products covering multiple related functions or related business units
Perform data analysis assignments, projects, visualization tasks, data quality improvements, and troubleshooting of data incidents, including the resolution of root causes.
Serve as a Subject Matter Expert in the application of SQL and statistical techniques to the acquisition, enrichment, and analysis of data.
Resolve and document solutions to track and manage incidents, changes, problems, tasks, and demands
Review and approve data views, design, and documentation by other team members to ensure governance standards and the utilization of appropriate technical components and techniques.
Serve as subject matter expert in the process, people, product, data, and systems of related business functions across a variety of business units and/or unrelated business functions within related business units (i.e. Oshkosh Segment)
Pursue and Define Business Problems & Opportunities
Propose and Define Relevant Dimensions & Measures
Collaborating with Data Engineers, draft and test data views to meet business needs for projects and products
Collaborating with Data Scientists, identify opportunities to incorporate predictive and prescriptive analytics, as well as machine learning and artificial intelligence into projects and products
Facilitate Conversations to Confirm Problems & Opportunities
Propose and Align Goals, Roles, and Sustainment Plans with Leaders
Coaches Leaders on Projects & Programs
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g. scientists, data engineers, business operations support, consultants) on data needs for business requirements on solutions which may be projects/products focused on a single business function that spans multiple business units or multiple related functions within a single business unit (Medium Complexity)
Apply technical writing and verbal communication skills to drive the change management (e.g. training plan, communications plan) and on-going management of data solutions.
Serve as a subject matter expert in Function/Business Unit/Digital Technology participation in Analytics Communities of Practice
Coach and teach business citizen analysts in building views and in analyzing, interpreting, and communicating data insights.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent.

Proficient with various web-based software applications including Power Bi Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

Attention to detail, problem solving, and decision-making skills.

new_jobs.title: AI Data Analyst (Predictive Intelligence & Agentic Systems)
new_jobs.description:
About The Client

Our client is a Dubai-based developer shaping the future of real estate and hospitality through technology-led, design-driven projects.

Their vision combines intelligent living, longevity and wellness, and autonomous systems within every development.

Operating across smart home technology, robotics and agentic AI, they are building homes that think, learn and respond.

They are assembling a high-calibre technology team to turn raw data into a truly predictive and personalised living experience.

Job Description: AI Data Analyst (Predictive Intelligence & Agentic Systems)

Mandatory Keywords:
Python, SQL, Data Lake, Machine Learning, Predictive Modeling, RAG, Vector Databases, Time-Series Analysis

Peripheral Keywords:
Spark, Flink, ETL/ELT, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, DuckDB, Apache Parquet, Pandas, NumPy, Pinecone, ChromaDB, Weaviate, LangChain, LangGraph, Ollama, OpenAI API, MQTT, Home Assistant, IoT Telemetry, Reinforcement Learning, Statistics, Anomaly Detection, Data Visualization, Dashboards, Data Privacy, GDPR

Role Overview

We are seeking a sophisticated AI Data Analyst to serve as the architect of intelligence for our ecosystem. You will be responsible for managing our comprehensive Data Lake, transforming raw telemetry from smart home devices and robotic integrations into actionable intelligence.

Your mission is to move beyond "reactive" automation. You will build the data pipelines and machine learning models that allow our Agentic Interfaces to anticipate user needs, recognise patterns of life, and provide a truly predictive, personalised experience. You will be the bridge between raw IoT data and the "brain" of our autonomous systems.

Key Responsibilities

Data Lake Management & Engineering
Architect and maintain a high-performance Data Lake to ingest, store, and process massive streams of event data from smart home devices, sensors, and robotic units
Design robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ensure data integrity, low-latency availability, and high-quality inputs for model training
Implement advanced Data Vectorization and Chunking strategies to prepare unstructured data for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and long-term agent memory
Pattern Analysis & Inference Training
Develop and deploy Machine Learning models to identify behavioural patterns (e.g., user routines, occupancy trends, and environmental preferences)
Conduct Inference Training to refine how our agents "reason" about user journeys, moving from simple triggers to complex anticipatory actions
Perform deep-dive Event Analysis to identify anomalies, optimise system performance, and improve the reliability of autonomous robot behaviours
Predictive Intelligence & Personalisation
Build the logic that powers Predictive Automation: ensuring the home doesn't just react to a command, but anticipates the user's next move
Develop "User Journey" models that allow our Agentic Interfaces to provide proactive assistance (e.g., preparing a meeting room before the user arrives or adjusting home climate based on predicted activity)
Collaborate with the Robotics and AI Engineering teams to feed personalised "profiles" into the agentic workflows
Analytics & Visualisation
Create internal dashboards to monitor the "health" of our intelligence, tracking model accuracy, prediction success rates, and data flow bottlenecks
Translate complex data findings into actionable product insights for the engineering and design teams

Requirements

Technical Requirements

Data Engineering: SQL, Python (Expert), Spark/Flink, Data Lake Architecture
Machine Learning: Scikit-learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow, Inference Optimisation, Reinforcement Learning (basics)
Vector Databases: Pinecone, ChromaDB, or Weaviate (experience with Vectorization & Chunking)
Data Processing: DuckDB, Apache Parquet, Pandas, NumPy
AI Frameworks: LangChain/LangGraph (for RAG data prep), OpenAI API, Ollama
IoT & Telemetry: MQTT, Home Assistant Data Exports, Time-Series Analysis
Mathematics: Probability, Statistics, Linear Algebra (for model training)

Preferred Qualifications

Data Science Background: A degree in Data Science, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
Predictive Modeling Experience: Proven experience building models that predict human behaviour or time-series events
RAG Expertise: Deep understanding of how to chunk and vectorise data for Large Language Models (LLMs)
Agentic Mindset: An understanding of how "Agents" differ from standard "Automations", focusing on reasoning and planning rather than just If/Then logic

Why This Role?

You won't be cleaning spreadsheets; you will be building the Cognitive Layer of a modern home. You will have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge data architectures and see your models directly influence how people interact with their physical environment. If you want to turn "Smart Homes" into "Intuitive Homes," this is your role.

Additional Suggestions For The Candidate

Portfolio Focus: We value candidates who can demonstrate a project involving time-series prediction, a custom RAG pipeline, or a complex data visualisation of IoT telemetry
Scalability Mindset: As the business grows, so will our data. We need someone who thinks about how to scale data ingestion from 10 homes to 10,000
Privacy First: You must have a strong understanding of data privacy and how to anonymise/secure sensitive user telemetry while still maintaining high-utility data for ML training

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive Tax-Free Salary: A market-leading monthly package in AED, commensurate with experience
Performance Incentives: Rewards linked to quality and delivery outcomes, as per Company Internal Policy
Visa & Medical Insurance: Full UAE visa sponsorship and comprehensive health cover
Paid Leave: As per Company Internal Policy and UAE Labour Law
Annual Flight Ticket & End-of-Service Gratuity: As per UAE market practice and Labour Law
Modern Tooling: Modern hardware plus cloud data and machine learning tools
Learning & Career Growth: Certification and conference support, with a clear path to leadership
Autonomy & Impact: Build the intelligence layer from the ground up and shape how AI is deployed in the physical world

new_jobs.description:
Title:
Data Analyst - Institutional Research

Employee Classification:
Other Professionals

Institution:
Roane State Community College

Roane State Community College

Job Summary

The IR Data Analyst develops data solutions that help Roane State Community College understand student outcomes, improve institutional operations, and make informed decisions. The position combines data analysis, business intelligence development, programming, and institutional research. The analyst develops data models, dashboards, reports, database queries, and analytical tools; conducts research and statistical analyses; and supports institutional, state, and federal reporting.

We are seeking candidates with strong analytical and technical skills who can translate complex questions into effective data solutions. Successful candidates may come from backgrounds in data analytics, business intelligence, data science, institutional research, computer science, statistics, social science research, or related fields.

This position may have the opportunity to work remotely within the state of Tennessee, with periodic visits to Roane State Community College Harriman Campus (Harriman, TN) at the employee’s expense, and potential travel to TBR colleges in Tennessee.

Job Duties

Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Development

Design, develop, and maintain dashboards, data models, reports, and other analytical tools that support institutional decision-making and operational effectiveness.
Develop database queries and programs to extract, transform, integrate, analyze, and present institutional data.
Collaborate with users to define business, research, and reporting needs and translate those needs into effective technical solutions.
Develop, test, document, maintain, and enhance applications and analytical products as institutional needs change.
Create clear, accessible visualizations and interfaces that communicate complex information to technical and nontechnical audiences.

Institutional Research and Reporting

Conduct research and analyze data for internal and external information requests, institutional projects, planning, and evaluation.
Apply appropriate research designs and statistical methods when developing analyses, surveys, data products, and reports.
Create and query databases, conduct descriptive and inferential analyses, and develop surveys to support institutional research and evaluation.
Prepare and validate data used for required state and federal reporting and assist with data-quality and compliance processes.
Respond to requests for institutional information and communicate findings, limitations, and implications to College stakeholders and external agencies.
Support grant development and reporting through data analysis and evaluation support.

Institutional and Technical Support

Manage the technical and logistical processes associated with student evaluations of faculty, including scheduling, troubleshooting, data processing, and distribution of results.
Develop and maintain web-based tools and content used to communicate institutional information.
Collaborate closely with the Director of Institutional Research and other College personnel on research, reporting, analytics, and data-development projects.
Participate in professional development, meetings, and College committees as requested.
Performs other duties as assigned in support of Institutional Research operations and the College’s mission.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, computer science, information systems, social science, business, public administration, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of relevant education, training, and 5 years of experience working in a related field. Experience working with databases and analyzing complex data.
Working knowledge of at least one analytical or programming language such as SQL, DAX, SAS, R, Python, or a comparable language.
Understanding of quantitative research methods, including research design and statistical analysis.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills.
Ability to exercise discretion and appropriately handle sensitive institutional data.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing dashboards and analytical solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable business intelligence platform. Intermediate to advanced proficiency in SQL or another database query language.
Experience with one or more analytical or programming languages such as DAX, R, Python, SAS, or comparable tools.
Experience with data modeling, data transformation, database design, or development of data marts.
Experience conducting statistical analyses or applying quantitative research methods.
Experience working with higher education, government, or other complex administrative data.
Experience communicating analytical findings to nontechnical audiences.
Graduate education in a relevant quantitative, technical, social science, or research-oriented field.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Ability to translate business and research questions into appropriate data models, analyses, dashboards, and technical solutions.
Knowledge of relational databases, data cleaning, data transformation, data validation, and analytical workflows.
Knowledge of quantitative research design, descriptive and inferential statistics, and responsible interpretation of findings.
Ability to evaluate data limitations and communicate conclusions without overstating what the evidence supports.
Ability to learn new analytical tools, programming languages, and data systems as institutional needs evolve.
Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines with accuracy and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with faculty, staff, administrators, and technical personnel.

In order to be considered for the position, the following items must be uploaded:

Application
Resume
3 professional references

Incomplete applications will not be considered.
